name: Princess Takorita
source:
The princess of Tako Kingdom, which is located deep under the sea. A strong-willed girl who likes to tease others.

Her hunch about food suddenly becomes sharp as she arrives on the land. She falls in love with the french fries, and she won't spare any effort to make the fries tastier.
